body.p: This Amendment No. {{amendment_number}} (this "Amendment") amends the {{agreement}} dated {{agreement_date}} (the "Agreement") between {{fontara_entity}} ("Vendor") and **{{customer}}**, {{customer_entity}} with its principal place of business at {{customer_address}}, {{customer_city}}, {{customer_region}} {{customer_postal}} ("Customer").
Background. The parties entered into the Agreement on the date stated above and now wish to amend it as set out in this Amendment. This background creates no obligations of its own.
This Amendment takes effect on {{effective}}. A provision of this Amendment has retroactive effect only where it expressly says so.

then.p: The total contract value of the Agreement is amended to {{currency}}{{contract_value}}, with an annual value of {{currency}}{{annual_value}}.

body.p: These are the only provisions of the Agreement this Amendment changes. If this Amendment conflicts with the Agreement, this Amendment governs.

Except as this Amendment expressly provides, the Agreement is unchanged and remains in full force and effect. This Amendment is the entire agreement of the parties on the changes it makes and supersedes all prior negotiations about them.

This Amendment may be signed in counterparts, each of which is an original, and by electronic signature through an electronic signature service, which is valid and binding. It is executed when the last party signs it.
This Amendment is governed by the law that governs the Agreement, and any dispute under it is resolved in the manner the Agreement provides.
